Here's an extended list of questions you can use in your interview:

```python
questions = {
    "Mathematical puzzles": [
        "If the value of x+y = 20 and x-y = 10, what is the value of x and y?",
        "If a pizza has a radius of 8 inches and is cut into 6 equal slices, what is the area of each slice?",
        "If 5 workers can complete a task in 3 hours, how long would it take 15 workers to complete the same task?",
        "Find the next number in the sequence: 1, 4, 9, 16, __"
    ],
    "Language puzzles": [
        "What word starts with 'e' and ends with 'e' but only contains one letter?",
        "I am taken from a mine, and shut up in a wooden case, from which I am never released, and yet I am used by almost every person. What am I?",
        "What word in English is pronounced the same when four of its five letters are removed?",
        "What has keys but can't open locks?"
    ],
    "Logic puzzles": [
        "You have 3 boxes. One contains only apples, one contains only oranges, and one contains both apples and oranges. The boxes have been incorrectly labeled such that no label identifies the actual contents of the box it labels. Opening just one box, and without looking in the box, you take out one piece of fruit. From that one piece of fruit, how can you immediately label all of the boxes correctly?",
        "Four people need to cross a bridge at night, which takes 1, 2, 7 and 10 minutes respectively. They have only one flashlight, and the bridge can hold a maximum of 2 people at a time. No one can cross without the flashlight. What is the shortest time they can all cross?"
    ],
    "Lateral thinking puzzles": [
        "A man lives on the 10th floor of a building. Every day he takes the elevator to the ground floor to go to work or to go shopping. When he returns he takes the elevator to the 7th floor and walks up the stairs to reach his apartment on the 10th floor. Why does he do this?",
        "A woman walks into a restaurant and orders a glass of water. The waiter pulls out a gun, but the woman doesn't react and gets up, pays her bill, and leaves. Why did the waiter do this?"
    ],
    "Pattern recognition puzzles": [
        "What is the next number in the sequence: 1, 3, 6, 10, 15, ___",
        "What is the missing number in the sequence: 2, 5, 10, 17, ___, 37",
        "Which number is the odd one out: 5, 9, 17, 23, 33",
        "Find the next letter in the sequence: A, E, I, ___"
    ]
}

for category in questions:
    print(f"{category}:")
    for question in questions[category]:
        print(f"- {question}")
```

Run the script, and you'll have a comprehensive list of questions to test the applicant's ability to solve various types of puzzles. This will help you evaluate their critical thinking and problem-solving skills crucial for the job.
